visualCharacteristics: Two-column intro: h2 section title beside a rich-text column (stacked below 1024); optional ice or dark band backgrounds and a split layout with two text columns.
contentPattern: Cell 1 = heading (h2/h3), cell 2 = paragraphs/lists; order-tolerant (first heading is the title, the rest is text); with split the first text row fills column 1 and later rows column 2.
usage: Use for a section introduction with a title next to (or above) one or two columns of body text.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any heading-plus-text intro section; add split for two text columns and ice/dark to match the surrounding band.
